Ephedra distachya on Epanomi Beach (Thessaloniki, Greece, 2026). Image L. Máté Tálas.

A shrub variable in height up to 3 or 4 ft, the branchlets rather rigid, with the joints 1⁄2 to 2 in. apart. Leaves 1⁄12 in. long. Male flower-spike usually solitary; female flowers in pairs. Fruit globose, 1⁄4 in. long, red. Native of S. and E. Europe; cultivated in the sixteenth century. Var. monostachya (L.) Stapf has solitary female flowers.
